gloss: cabinet minister; member of the cabinet

definitions.gloss: cabinet minister; member of the cabinet
definitions.explanation: A government official who serves as a member of the cabinet, typically heading a ministry or government department.

examples.japanese: {閣僚|かくりょう}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{閣僚|かくりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new cabinet minister was appointed.

examples.japanese: {閣僚|かくりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ことで、⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧⟦{改造|かいぞう}→改造：00145_kaizou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A cabinet reshuffle was carried out after one of the ministers resigned.

notes:
A formal term for members of the national cabinet. In Japan, {閣僚|かくりょう} refers to ministers who serve under the ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧⟦{総理|そうり}{大臣|だいじん}→総理大臣：15205_souridaijin⟧ (Prime Minister). The word combines {閣|かく} (cabinet/council) and {僚|りょう} (colleague/official).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閣僚|かくりょう}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: cabinet meeting
- {閣僚|かくりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint a cabinet minister
- {閣僚|かくりょう}⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧: cabinet appointments
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧{閣僚|かくりょう}: all cabinet members
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧{閣僚|かくりょう}: relevant ministers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧: minister — the title of individual cabinet members (e.g., ⟦{外務|がいむ}→外務：24160_gaimu⟧⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧ "Minister of Foreign Affairs")
- ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧: cabinet — the body itself, not the individual members
- ⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧: politician — broader term for anyone in politics
